input_allocation.scope: Input-only first-stage allocation; not effects on inflation expectations.

q9_postprocessing.coverage_semantics: Original plus resumed raw call ledger. Failed calls stay missing; analysis uses normalized Q9.

paired_intervals_actual_support.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

random_quantity_minus_fixed_8.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

random_quantity_uniform_topics_minus_ran.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

runtime.aggregation: Sum new actual requests/reported fees/runtime across original and never-attempted continuation; final combined reserve already includes prior charges.

limits: Historical and 2025 months already inspected for model choice; only new news-mechanism execution, not a wholly unseen test.
Older months have96 people, recent months192; paired within month and equal-month aggregate, not equal precision.
News count is a design setting, not a measured reading rate; external demographic predictor has weak holdout gains.
Only one quantity allocation seed; two LLM generations do not measure allocation uncertainty.
Uniform-theme contrast changes actual texts and may alter lengths/topics; no claim of equal semantic information.
Archived controls and future calls are not simultaneous; fixed route/model and input hashes do not prove weights unchanged.
A conditional reconstruction uses real prior beliefs; no strict B or training-contamination exclusion claim.
Fixed-roster results include separately counted previous-answer fallbacks; they are not pure model responses.
Conditional groups are descriptive; calendar months and demographic cells are not new randomized experiments.
Only actually run combinations can be selected; demographic quantity plus uniform themes has not been run.
Development screening is not a multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim or a final default upgrade.
